Ethereal Voidsplinter is the Catalyst currency during The War Within Season 3. It accumulates by one every two weeks up to a total of 8. Players also earn one from the Crystallized Ethereal Voidsplinter from The War Within Season 3: Voidborne Victor. During the Season 3 Turbo Boost event, voidsplinters can also drop from Mythic+ dungeons, Manaforge Omega, delves, and rated PvP.
Ethereal Stall summons a K'areshi Stall. This item is sold by Shad'anis at Overlook Zo'Shuul on K'aresh for .

Ethereal Strands is a hidden tracking currency used to upgrade the Reshii Wraps, obtained in the Ghosts of K'aresh campaign during The War Within Season 3. Characters can acquire 15 total strands to acquire five upgrades from Hashim at Overlook Zo'Shuul in K'aresh. Strands can be earned from delves (including Tier 1 delves!), Mythic+, PvP, Manaforge Omega, and completing Warrants. The first three come from The Tabiqa, the final quest of chapter three of the campaign. Players can acquire six in the first week of the patch, and three every week after.

Etheric Brannmorpher is available for 10 Resonance Crystals from Reno Jackson at Delver's Headquarters in Dornogal after reaching Tier 10 on the The War Within Season 3 Delver's Journey. It summons an Ethereal Brannmorpher that can grant you the visage of Brann Bronzebeard and the Bronzebeard title.
Everburning Lump is a trash item that drops from Candles and waxes in The Ringing Deeps and Darkflame Cleft. It can also be found in Missing Scout's Pack.

Ethereal X was a void ethereal of the Shadowguard. Prior to the War of Light and Shadow, Ethereal X wandered the deserts of K'aresh until he opened a Void portal, unaware that Alleria Windrunner was following him. In the Voidstorm, he knelt before Xal'atath and offered himself to her service, only to be absorbed into the Dark Heart and used by the Harbinger to create the Voidspire.

Exile's Reach quilboar are a tribe of quilboar inhabiting Quilboar Briarpatch in Exile's Reach. They serve the Darkmaul ogre, overseen by an Ogre Overseer. Just like their masters, they began practicing and using necromancy. When the Alliance and Horde expeditions shipwrecked on the isle, the quilboar ambushed and captured them. The two factions then sent another expedition and began searching for survivors, soon encountering the quilboar. Both Austin Huxworth and Mithdran Dawntracker spied on them, before the faction recruits entered the Briarpatch and killed several of the quilboar. Further in the area, their chief, Geolord Grek'og, was conducting a ritual on Lindie Springstock and Cork Fi

Expertly Done is an exploration achievement earned by gathering a group of experts to assist in the Oasis in K'aresh. This requires completing Smell Ya Later, part of the "Roaming Free" chapter of the Ghosts of K'aresh campaign. This achievement is one of the criteria of Ecological Succession.
Explore K'aresh is an exploration achievement earned by exploring K'aresh, revealing covered areas of the map. This is one of the criteria of the meta-achievement Unraveled and Persevering.
Expired Goods concludes the optional "Lost and Found Storage" chapter of the Ghosts of K'aresh campaign. Find Vaultkeeper Xy'vez in Astral Getaways in northeastern Tazavesh to begin.
Experiment Instructions are provided by Eternus for Infinite Chaos.
Experimental Go-Pack are sold by Sally Boltwrench for 10 Flame-Blessed Iron in Flotsam Shoal on Siren Isle. They can only be used on Siren Isle.

Explore Antoran Wastes is a Legion Remix achievement earned by exploring the Antoran Wastes, revealing the covered areas of the world map with a Timerunner. While the achievement is in the game, no player earned it due to the event ending a day before patch 12.0.0 came out.

Explore Eredath is a Legion Remix achievement earned by exploring Eredath, revealing the covered areas of the world map with a Timerunner. While the achievement is in the game, no player earned it due to the event ending a day before patch 12.0.0 came out.

Explore Krokuun is a Legion Remix achievement earned by exploring Krokuun, revealing the covered areas of the world map with a Timerunner. While the achievement is in the game, no player earned it due to the event ending a day before patch 12.0.0 came out.

The Experimental Punisher is a centurion found next to Famos at the Eternal Forge in Bastion. It is initially inactive, but when Famos reaches 50 % health, she will jump into the centurion and it will become attackable.
Explore Harandar is an exploration achievement earned for exploring the entire map of the Harandar zone. Required for the meta-achievements That's Aln, Folks! and The Midnight Explorer.
Explore Voidstorm is an exploration achievement earned for exploring the entire map of the Voidstorm zone. Required for the meta-achievements Yelling into the Voidstorm and The Midnight Explorer.
Explore Zul'Aman is an exploration achievement earned for exploring the entire map of the Zul'Aman zone. Required for the meta-achievements Making an Amani Out of You and The Midnight Explorer.
Experiment Subjects are various types of devourers found just outside the Forbidden Library at the Banewood in Revendreth. While most of them are dead, a couple of mites are still alive in cages.
Expert Challenge: Tendrils is an expansion feature achievement earned by disrupting any Ritual Site with the Tendrils challenge present on Tier 5.

Expert in Battle is a player vs. player achievement earned by participating in 100 instanced PvP matches.
Explore the Coiled Isle is an exploration achievement earned by exploring the Coiled Isle, revealing the covered areas of the world map.

Expelled Gluttonies are small manifestations found attacking the Ember Court during Party Crashers!. Alternative names that these can have are Expelled Craving, Expelled Hunger, and Expelled Indulgence.

Expelled Rages are small manifestations found attacking the Ember Court during Party Crashers!. Alternative names that these can have are Expelled Anger, Expelled Enmity, Expelled Fury, Expelled Hatred, Expelled Malice, Expelled Rancor, and Expelled Wrath.

Experimental Sludges are oozes found in the first room of the Greaseworks in the Other Side. They continuously spawn on the right side of the room and move across to the left side, despawning when they reach it.

Exploding Corpse Snakes is a Prey affix that appears during hard and nightmare hunts. Two Venom-Bloated Pythons may spawn after killing an mob. Upon reaching 0% health, it will explode in a 6-yard AoE that deals heavy Nature damage and knock back. Killing 200 of these snakes while on a hard or nightmare hunt is required for the Kill Me Now achievement.
Exploding Map is obtained from the Wild Arcana at the Cobalt Assembly.
Extraplanar Spidersilk Boots are created with Tailoring (150); taught by speaking with the Shadowy Figure after obtaining a Shard of the Void.
Exquisite Love Boat is available during Love is in the Air for 270x Love Token from Lythianne Morningspear in Durotar and Kiera Torres in Elwynn Forest.
Explosive Plague Mixtures are barrels located in the Sepulcher and Fenris Isle in Silverpine Forest during the Heritage of Lordaeron.

The Eye of Bhossca is looted from the Padlocked Reliquary in the Scarlet Monastery Library.
Extract Gem is taught to players who loot any gem in Pandaria Remix, allowing them to safely extract gems from gear so they can be upgraded or swapped around.
Explosive Bomberbots are clockwork robots located in the Ritual Hall in the Hall of Awakening during the Awakening the Machine event.
